items.headline: Nvidia hits all-time high as Huang joins Trump China trip
items.summary: NVDA trading around $225 reached new record as Jensen Huang accompanies Trump to Beijing for May 14-15 summit. Air Force One stopped in Alaska to pick up Nvidia CEO.

items.headline: Tesla officially ends Model S and X production
items.summary: Elon Musk confirms custom orders have ended with only ~600 units left in inventory globally. Fremont lines converting to Optimus robot production with 1M unit/year target.

items.headline: Palantir delivers record Q1 beat, raises full-year guidance
items.summary: Q1 revenue jumped 85% to $1.63B (vs est. $1.53B), EPS $0.33 (vs est. $0.28). Company raised FY guidance to $7.65-7.66B, up from $7.18-7.20B prior.

items.headline: AMD crushes Q1 estimates, stock jumps 6% after hours
items.summary: Q1 EPS $1.37 vs est. $1.28, revenue $10.25B vs est. $9.89B. Data center revenue $5.8B, up 57% YoY. Q2 guidance $10.9-11.5B vs est. $10.52B.

items.headline: Alphabet capex to significantly accelerate in 2027
items.summary: Management notes capex spending already elevated at $180-190B in 2026 will 'significantly accelerate' in 2027 to support AI infrastructure buildout.

items.headline: Amazon plans $200B AI infrastructure spend through 2026
items.summary: Amazon still plans to dish out ~$200B on AI infrastructure, with less than 25% spent as of Q1 end. Company remains major Nvidia customer.

items.headline: Meta among top AI spenders as infrastructure race intensifies
items.summary: Meta Platforms continues aggressive AI chip purchases alongside hyperscaler peers. Nvidia expanding infrastructure support for Meta as AI race accelerates.

items.headline: Constellation Energy falls 7.8% on May 13 session
items.summary: CEG declined 7.8% in Wednesday trading as part of broader market rotation. Stock remains key beneficiary of data center power demand.

items.headline: Micron bulls say 'even more confident now' ahead of results
items.summary: Memory stock momentum continues with DRAM ETF soaring nearly 30% in recent week. Analysts increasingly bullish on memory demand supporting AI infrastructure.

items.headline: Broadcom up nearly 40% since April, Citi says 'best chip name in 2026'
items.summary: AVGO surges on custom AI chip momentum. Citi raises price target ahead of June 3 earnings, citing CEO Hock Tan's projection of $100B+ custom AI chip revenue.
